'''Xa Fel''' was a populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Xa Fel (species)|Xa Fel]]. The planet readily supported all forms of life.

==History==
Xa Fel joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the planet environment was devastated.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The unscrupulous manner in which [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] managed the facility left the world terribly polluted and eroded, devoid of natural resources.

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the planet was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] world that surrendered to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harbid]] and [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces after a thirty-hour [[Battle of Xa Fel (9 ABY)|battle]].<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], a task force of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]], including [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], was sent to the system to enforce several judicial verdicts and decrees made against KDY that directed them to clean up their operations and to detoxify the planet itself. Within minutes of their arrival, a task force of [[Invids]] led by the ''[[Invidious]]'' and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Leonia Tavira]] herself arrived to obtain [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] to sell to other warlords.

In the ensuing fleet action and dogfights, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], then under the alias [[Jenos Idanian]], provided a solution to the Invids that would allow them to withdraw sooner without bringing undue harm to the New Republic forces. Unfortunately, as he fought for his own life while maintaining cover, he inadvertently drew the attention of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] to himself though later he would pass it off as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] having participated in the battle, leading the Rogues there.

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Kanchen Sector and, consequently, Xa Fel, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
